deck_markdown:
**Punchline:** Approve Option 1 Thursday: renew Marina Tower for three years at AED 2.87M/yr and secure the adjacency right.

## Title sequence
1. Renew Marina Tower for three years with the adjacency right.
2. This renewal costs less and avoids relocation disruption.
3. A one-year renewal costs more and forfeits the adjacency right.
4. That right covers growth through year 5 if exercised.
5. Approve Option 1 Thursday so legal can complete this month.

---

## Slide 1 — Renew Marina Tower for three years with the adjacency right.
**Headline:** Renew Marina Tower for three years with the adjacency right.

**Spotlight:** Option 1 offers AED 2.87M/yr fixed, 2.4% below current rent, with no disruption and an already-amortized fit-out. It includes a right of first refusal on the adjacent 6,200 sq ft. Facilities, Finance, and the practice heads concur. Source: Operations lease-decision memo, Option 1 and recommendation.

**Design note:** Show the annual rent and three-year term prominently, with the first-refusal right beside them.

---

## Slide 2 — This renewal costs less and avoids relocation disruption.
**Headline:** This renewal costs less and avoids relocation disruption.

| Measure | Option 1: Marina Tower renewal | Option 2: DIFC Gate Avenue relocation |
|---|---|---|
| Annual rent | AED 2.87M fixed | AED 3.55M |
| Area | 18,400 sq ft | 16,900 sq ft |
| Fit-out and moving | Existing fit-out already amortized | Estimated AED 4.1M |
| Productivity | No disruption | Estimated 3–4 weeks of degraded productivity |

**Spotlight:** DIFC offers better client optics for the advisory practice, but 22% of staff would face materially longer commutes. Operations places break-even versus Option 1 beyond year 6, past the planning horizon. Source: Operations lease-decision memo, Options 1–2.

**Design note:** Use a two-column comparison; place the client-optics benefit beneath the DIFC column.

---

## Slide 3 — A one-year renewal costs more and forfeits the adjacency right.
**Headline:** A one-year renewal costs more and forfeits the adjacency right.

**Spotlight:** Option 3 costs AED 3.02M/yr, a 2.7% short-term premium. It keeps flexibility but repeats the lease exercise in nine months and forfeits the first-refusal right. The landlord attaches that right only to a multi-year term. Source: Operations lease-decision memo, Option 3.

**Design note:** Pair the flexibility benefit with the higher rent and lost first-refusal right, without implying flexibility has no value.

---

## Slide 4 — That right covers growth through year 5 if exercised.
**Headline:** That right covers growth through year 5 if exercised.

**Spotlight:** Base-case headcount projections put Marina Tower at capacity in roughly 30 months. The adjacent 6,200 sq ft vacates in Q3 next year; exercising the first-refusal right covers growth through year 5. Renewal secures the right; the capacity benefit depends on exercise. Source: Operations lease-decision memo, Option 1 and headcount projections.

**Design note:** Show the adjacent space beside the current footprint. Label the growth coverage "Base case; if exercised."

---

## Slide 5 — Approve Option 1 Thursday so legal can complete this month.
**Headline:** Approve Option 1 Thursday so legal can complete this month.

**Spotlight:** Approve the three-year renewal at AED 2.87M/yr and secure the adjacency right. Operations requests approval Thursday so legal can complete by month-end. The decision deadline is 15 October to keep all options open; the current lease expires 31 January. Source: Operations lease-decision memo, opening and recommendation.

**Design note:** Put the approval wording first, followed by the three source-stated milestones: Thursday, month-end, and 15 October.
